name: Average Intensity Projection
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays from the camera through the volume and accumulates voxel values along the ray path. Unlike standard front-to-back compositing, this method computes the arithmetic mean of the sampled values (weighted by opacity) to produce an Average Intensity Projection.
summary: Average Intensity Projection is a volume rendering technique that computes the arithmetic mean of voxel intensities along rays, treating the volume as a transparent medium where every sample contributes equally.
